scale.0: No usable proof or a critical prerequisite is absent.
scale.25: Scaffold exists but the outcome is not operational.
scale.50: Implemented and locally or CI verified; end-to-end proof is incomplete.
scale.75: Operational core is proven; important quality or outcome gaps remain.
scale.100: Maximum-quality target is proven end-to-end and instrumented.

scoring_policy.missing_evidence_policy: Missing evidence never counts as success.
scoring_policy.comparison_rule: Only compatible persisted rubrics are compared day to day.

system_intelligence_goal.big_goal: Consistently choose the highest-leverage work, execute safe improvements end-to-end, learn from failures, reduce rework, and prove live outcomes without false success.

rubric.name: Strategic clarity and decision quality
rubric.evidence: Decision quality improved because the system now selects exactly three non-healthy strategic actions through a deterministic formula using confirmed goal gap, expected rubric impact, portfolio leverage, evidence state, readiness and stall risk instead of defect volume or intuition alone.

rubric.name: Execution completion and automation leverage
rubric.evidence: Execution resilience improved through a deterministic recovery loop that detects stale publication evidence and re-dispatches the canonical path without converting retry activity into success evidence.

rubric.name: Live verification, learning and replay
rubric.evidence: Evidence quality improved because source-type proof is now validated before scoring: merged PRs require merge proof, live claims require exact timestamp, source, receipt and visible-surface equality, and observed outcomes require a named metric with a bounded measurement window.

rubric.name: Portfolio visibility, efficiency and business awareness
rubric.evidence: Portfolio visibility and efficiency improved because collector coverage, health, overdue state, stalled targets, blocked dependencies and exact Top-3 actions are now generated as a durable plan and validated by both Strategic Goal publication and Agent Harness Validators. Actual retry-cost and business-outcome counters remain absent and are not credited.
